description: Tell maviapi that an endpoint that exists returns the wrong thing: it fails, comes back empty, or repeats the same page. Use this instead of asking for a changed version when the endpoint is simply broken: the fix lands on the endpoint itself, for everyone. maviapi replays the call at once and then runs its own check of the endpoint. If that check fails too the report is confirmed and the endpoint is queued for repair; if not (a fault only certain parameters show, a repeated page, wrong values) a person on the team reads the report. A report's status is confirmed, fixed or received. Report what you saw: maviapi takes a report of an API only from an account that has called it with its own key, so make the failing call with call_api first, then pass its `params` here. Without `endpoint` and `description` it lists the reports made with this key. Needs an API key with the requests:write permission (any request permission to list).

api.description: API slug (e.g. "booking") or the site's domain.

description.description: What is wrong, in a sentence or two: what you asked for, what came back, what you expected. E.g. "page=2 returns the same 30 restaurants as page 1."

endpoint.description: The endpoint's name or path, e.g. "/restaurants".

params.description: The parameters of a call that shows the fault, e.g. {"geo": "187147", "page": 2}.

name: report_endpoint_issue
title: Report a broken maviapi endpoint
